substeps.caption: The alloy route's chapter 5, in the lab as it was set up: the print comes out of the Aconity MIDI and is depowdered, the wire EDM across the aisle cuts the four tensile bars off it, they are heat treated on tray F, then two are pulled in the Instron 68FM-100, at room temperature and at 200 C.

The print is done: four ASTM E8 subsize tensile bars, 100 mm long and 6 mm thick, printed flat on a 170 mm plate from the route's own Al-10Si powder (DAL PR #169's build at Utah), and a handling lug for the gripper. They are still buried in powder; the chamber is drawn see-through.
